research_question: Does expert labeling of states actually visited by failing PilotNet V1 improve 0.50 m/s closed-loop robustness?

dagger_rollout_A.source: Failure Diagnosis V1 preserved rollout; no rerun

dagger_rollout_B.source: one new independent V1 0.50 m/s shadow rollout

alignment.common_clock: raw camera header simulator time and shadow telemetry simulator clock
alignment.policy: latest shadow-expert state at or before camera header time

window_rule: continuous trajectory from 1.0 s before objective CTE divergence onset through final valid pre-safe-stop frame; full active fallback only below 20 frames

decision.reason: V3 reduced independent on-policy holdout error and progressed materially farther at 0.50 m/s, but did not complete a lap.
decision.next_experiment: A second bounded DAgger iteration using states actually visited near the new V3 failure around 19.82 m is justified later; it was not run here.
